insight: GitHub's official MCP server (not a community port) — rewritten in Go and also offered as a GitHub-hosted remote endpoint.
name: GitHub MCP
tagline: Reads + writes GitHub from any MCP-aware agent.
description: Official GitHub MCP server. Wired into Claude Code and most agentic surfaces to read PRs, post comments, create branches, and run secret-scanning.
edge: GitHub's first-party MCP — exposes PRs, issues, and even secret-scanning, gated by GitHub's native permission model.
pros: Honors GitHub permissions and OAuth scopes
cons: Subject to GitHub API rate limits
Can't initiate a review from scratch
PAT scope tuning needed to expose tools
